payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the introduced approach on the RACE dataset, detailing the percentage boosts over previous models.

claims.text: DFN leads to a 7.8% performance boost over GA on RACE-M.
DFN leads to a 7.3% performance boost over Stanford AR on RACE-M.
On RACE-H, DFN outperforms GA by 1.5% and Stanford AR by 2.7%.
Ensemble models gained a performance boost of 4-5% compared to previous methods.
